Take classes online, anytime, anywhere. Purdue University is a public university located in West Lafayette, Indiana. We are one of the nation's leading research institutions with a reputation for excellent and affordable education. Building on Purdue University's historic land-grant mission, our online programs are designed to make a high-quality Purdue education as accessible and affordable as possible.

Explore online degrees, professional development opportunities and continuing education programs across the Purdue University system: https://purdue.edu/online.
